The [[About Picture-in-Picture in Firefox|Picture-in-picture feature]] allows you to pop videos out of their webpages and watch them in floating windows while you work in other tabs. 
<!--copied from Template:enablep2p, which we no longer need (dee discussion)-->
If you don’t want to see the controls while hovering, you can hide that option in Firefox. (Note: You can still turn on picture-in-picture view by right-clicking a video.) Or you can use this to re-enable the control when you want to use it again.
{for not fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
# In the {menu General} panel, scroll down to the ''Browsing'' section.
#Clear the check mark for '''Enable picture-in-picture video controls'''.
#;[[Image:Fx111settings-UncheckPIP]]
{/for}
{for fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
# Select {menu Tabs and browsing} on the left and scroll down to the ''Media'' section.
#Clear the check mark for '''Use Picture-in-Picture'''.
#;[[Image:fx152media]]
{/for}
If you later want to re-enable the controls, simply add back the check mark.
